title: LUBRICATION
summary: Lubrication chart, sheet 4: code 15a (9985014 rust-proofing oil, diluted 1:9, sprayed over the engine compartment after final assembly except under the hood), 18a and 18c (9985146 special lubricant: accelerator cable ball stud, M20 heavy-duty 4-speed fill), 32a (9985196 rust preventive on battery terminals) and 33a (9985169 hypoid lube, rear axle).
notes_internal: Table: PART column filled down to every code row of its block (printed once per block). Multi-line cells joined with single spaces; syllable hyphens at line breaks removed (e.g. 'CHAN-NELS' -> 'CHANNELS'), real dashes kept. Diamond symbol after each code omitted.
Circled 1 sits in the empty space below 15a (where the removed 9985192 entry was). Circled 2 and 3 sit between 18a and 18c (where removed 18b was). Circled 4 next to 33a.
Rev 1 'was' set to the removed lubricant pn 9985192 (removed, not replaced).
Revision text is handwritten; 'G81' read as the RPO code (positraction); first rev date reads 12-12-69, third 2-9-70.
